verdict.rationale: Founder Law's own rebrand page states a posture on legal automation: automated tools handle forms at scale, while complex, high-stakes founder cases need an attorney accountable for the outcome. That implies attorney ownership of its petitions, but it never describes how the firm itself uses AI in drafting or review. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of which drafting or review steps (if any) are AI-automated, a description of what the attorney checks or signs off, and a dedicated AI-use or methodology page.
